title: Accessibility tests for operator-facing surfaces
question: Layer 35 (:11023). For the cockpit and any UI surface, do contrast ratios, focus visibility, keyboard reachability and screen-reader labels hold; and for terminal surfaces, is the line readable under NO_COLOR and monochrome with no double-width glyph?
answer: PASS: cockpit status line and panes use width-1 ASCII glyphs; NO_COLOR keeps [FOCUS]/[OK] tokens; dark and light theme PPM pixels meet the 4.5:1 (text) and 3:1 (focus) floors; a yellow-on-white decoy and a planted U+26A0 fail the same detectors.

surfaces.status_plain: > program [FOCUS] theme=dark events=0 receipts=64 status=[OK] keys:a=agents c=codex d=databricks h=health m=mcp p=program
surfaces.screen_reader:
surface: operator status
label: focused_pane value: program
label: theme value: dark
label: events value: 0
label: receipts value: 64
label: status value: OK
label: keyboard_map value: a reaches agents, c reaches codex, d reaches databricks, h reaches health, m reaches mcp, p reaches program
role: status
focus_visible: token [FOCUS] and prefix >

tests.requirement: Every glyph on the status surface and cockpit panes occupies exactly one terminal cell (East Asian Width / cell-width scan).
tests.evidence: live_double_width=0 planted_hits=2 status_glyphs=121 planted_line='status WARN ⚠ 中 align\n'

tests.requirement: NO_COLOR/monochrome rendering keeps the same tokens as the coloured line after SGR strip; status is not colour-only.
tests.evidence: stripped_equals_plain=True color_only_collapsed=True NO_COLOR_env=True plain='> program [FOCUS] theme=dark events=0 receipts=64 status=[OK] keys:a=agents c=codex d=databricks h=health m=mcp p=program'

tests.requirement: WCAG contrast from rendered PPM pixels meets the declared 4.5:1 text floor in dark and light themes; a yellow-on-white decoy fails.
tests.evidence: dark_fg=15.8802 light_fg=16.9947 dark_focus=13.4206 light_focus=8.4214 decoy=1.0738 captures={'dark': 'command-center/p2-wave/probes/TST-0114/captures/theme-dark.ppm', 'light': 'command-center/p2-wave/probes/TST-0114/captures/theme-light.ppm', 'decoy': 'command-center/p2-wave/probes/TST-0114/captures/decoy-low-contrast.ppm'}

tests.requirement: Focus is a token (not colour alone); every pane has a key; the screen-reader dump labels each status field.

evidence.note: Per-glyph East Asian Width scan of live cockpit panes and status lines; planted U+26A0 fired (2 hit(s)).
Coloured status stripped of SGR equals the NO_COLOR render; tokens [FOCUS] and [OK] remain.

does_not_claim: a GUI screenshot of an external window
scope.proof_surface: live Cockpit.render_status_line / render_pane; PPM captures per theme; independent luminance in probe2

reviewer.notes: Probe 2 re-parses the PPM and recomputes WCAG luminance without calling operator_surface.contrast_ratio. Probe 1 re-scans live glyphs and NO_COLOR independently of this emit.
